lines.pt1: First, pretraining. The model reads a huge amount of text, and learns to predict the next word.
lines.pt2: The result is a base model. It is great at continuing text, but it is not yet a helpful assistant.
lines.ft1: Next, fine tuning on example conversations teaches it to follow instructions.
lines.ft2: Now the same question gets a direct answer.
lines.rl1: Then comes human feedback. People compare pairs of answers, and a reward model learns their preferences.
lines.rl2: The model is nudged toward answers people rate higher. This is called reinforcement learning from human feedback.
lines.outro: Pretraining teaches language, fine tuning teaches the format, and feedback teaches what people prefer. Together, they turn a text predictor into an assistant.
